items.name: H Company Holo4
items.summary: A new series of agentic computer-use models in 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE sizes with open weights on Hugging Face. Holo4 27B scores 85.2% on OSWorld at $0.08/task — near frontier closed-model scores at a fraction of the cost — driving GUIs, code, MCP and APIs through one unified model.

items.name: NaiveAI Naive-N0.5-Flash
items.summary: A 309B-parameter MoE open-weight model (15.5B active) with 1M-token context targeting coding and AI research, from a Beijing startup claiming AI systems did substantial parts of the research and engineering. Ships alongside its custom NaiveRT inference runtime; capability claims are company-reported.

items.name: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic's newest flagship Claude model, described as its strongest-performing model to date. It tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 58, costs ~40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads ($4/$20 per M tokens), and adds "preserved thinking" anti-distillation safeguards.

items.name: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.summary: Two cheaper siblings of GPT-6 Astra expanding the GPT-6 family — Sol ($2/$10 per M tokens) targets complex coding and agentic workflows, Luna ($0.10/$0.50) targets high-volume focused tasks. Both priced 50% below their GPT-5.6 counterparts' promotional rates, via caching and inference efficiency gains.

items.name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro
items.summary: The new top open-weights model worldwide, scoring 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. The 1T-parameter MoE (42B active) is released under the MIT license with weights on Hugging Face, priced roughly 1/10th of the closed frontier models.
